title: A new address lookup calls an outside service with no time limit and no plan for it failing
diff:
diff --git a/app/services/geocode.py b/app/services/geocode.py
--- a/app/services/geocode.py
+++ b/app/services/geocode.py
@@ -5,3 +5,8 @@
 
 def normalise(address: str) -> str:
     return " ".join(address.split()).title()
+
+
+def lookup_address(address: str) -> dict:
+    response = requests.get(GEOCODER_URL, params={"q": normalise(address)})
+    return response.json()
